concept: Making a fair decision when group members disagree, without just picking favorites
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student leads a group project where two members have a genuine, reasonable disagreement about direction
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides how to resolve it fairly rather than simply siding with a friend
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what made the decision feel fair or unfair to the group

assessment.success_marker: student's process weighs the merits of both ideas rather than personal loyalty alone
